content.comment_body: Hello, I followed the example, but I'm unsure how to display the counter value in the [product_name] Web Editor. The value appears to be of DINT type, and I can't locate any flag or network output using DW data type. Thanks in advance. --- Split from Flow measuring with water meter.
In the "Tools" menu, use the Parameter VM Mapping feature.
Thank you, I learned something new today.

analysis.insight_summary: A user encountered difficulty in displaying a counter value within the [product_name] Web Editor, primarily due to data type compatibility issues, such as handling DINT values and finding suitable network outputs. Another participant directed them to use VM Mapping under Tools, which resolved the problem and enhanced the user's understanding. The discussion highlights challenges around discoverability and managing data types within visualization workflows.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate an easy-to-use method for presenting counter values of any data type in the visualization system, as well as clear options for transferring DINT data for online monitoring.
